abstract: The general ranking problem has widespread applications including commercial search engines. RankBoost is an efficient ranking algorithm for combining preference in these areas. But it is not widely used because of its long training time. Graphics Processing Units(GPUs) have become powerful parallel processing tools for general purpose computing. In this paper, we use CUDA compatible GPU to accelerate RankBoost training procedure. Based on the parallel architecture of GPU, we propose two mapping schemes: One-Feature-One-Thread (OFOT) and One Feature-Multiple-Thread (OFMT). Different training data-sets lead to different speedups using our mapping schemes. For training data sets from a commercial search engine, the OFOT is better, achieving a 30× speedup; for random data, the OFMT is better achieving a 60× speedup.

articleTitle: An improved capturing algorithm based on particle swarm optimization for swarm robots system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In recent years, the number of researches in which swarm intelligence shown by individual communication in swarm robots is increasing. As one of the representative algorithms in swarm intelligence, particle swarm optimization has been applied to many fields because of its simple concept, easy realizing and good optimization characteristics. However, it still has some disadvantages such as easy falling in the local best situation and solving the discrete optimization problems poor. In this paper, a swarm-robot capturing algorithm which is based on particle swarm optimization and assimilates outstanding advantages of fruit fly algorithm is proposed. Robots in the simulation environment complete the task that rescuing the victim with the algorithm in a disaster. The simulation in Player/Stage shows that the algorithm can make up the disadvantages of particle swarm optimization and complete the capturing well at the same time.

articleTitle: The apprentice modeling through reinforcement with a temporal analysis using the Q-learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This work aims to create the simulations by varying the alpha (a — Learning rate) and Gamma (y — Time reduction) values, such parameters found in the q-learning algorithm, which is possible to analyze the algorithms convergence, on what concerns the variations of these parameters. This work seeks to state that the parameters variations of Alpha and Gamma interfere on the convergence of Q-learning algorithm, thus, in the ITS learning.

articleTitle: Automatic clustering method of multivariate data using Gaussian Dirichlet process mixture model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Finite mixture models have largely been used for providing a convenient format framework for clustering and classification for multivariate data. But most of these models assume that the number of components in mixture model is known in advance. To resolve this issue, we introduce a novel nonparametric Bayesian clustering model, is called Gaussian Dirichlet process mixture model, for the automatic clustering algorithm of multivariate data, and we have also described an efficient variational Bayesian inference algorithm for the proposed model. We apply it to a series of various clustering problems, demonstrating its advantages over existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Image thresholding based on parzen window estimation and Renyi entropy
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Image segmentation is an important problem of digital image processing and also a common difficult problem. In this paper, a new image thresholding method based on Parzen-window estimation and Renyi entropy is proposed. The method used Parzen-window technology to estimate the spatial probability distribution of image gray level values, then combined with the Renyi entropy to construct a new criterion function, and at last searched the optimal global threshold in the scope of gray level to maximum the criterion function. This new method has some advantages, such as high accuracy to image segmentation, fine stability comparing with the traditional Renyi entropy method.

articleTitle: Heuristics on optimal vehicle routing for Permutation Circulation-type Vehicle Routing System with short-cut
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: We treat with an automated material handling system which we call Permutation Circulation-type Vehicle Routing System with short-cut (denoted PCVRS). In the PCVRS a fleet of vehicles unidirectionally and repeatedly circulates on a single loop, and carry items to stations which are placed along the loop. One of the important issues for the PCVRS to be efficiently operated is to minimize interference or blocking between vehicles, which may deteriorate system performances. We analyze three vehicle routing rules which allocate jobs to station and show effect of optimization for a real system by means of simulation.

articleTitle: A novel distributed ranking method based on activator-inhibitor model for multicellular array architecture
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel distributed ranking method based on activator-inhibitor model theory for multicellular array architecture. Cell ranking in multicellular array means that sequence number 1, 2, ···, n have to be assigned to the different cells. This method has two characteristics: 1) it's an active cell ranking and sequence number maintaining method compared to existing passive cell sequence number maintaining methods in multicellular array architectures; 2) it doesn't need initial value to rank and maintain cell sequence numbers, which is different from ordinary distributed ranking methods based on initial values. This method imitates the active sequence maintain mechanism in organisms to eliminate the single-point-of-failure properties of existing cell sequence number maintaining methods. Fault-injection experiments show our method has better robustness than existing methods.

articleTitle: Resource allocation for wireless ad hoc networks with multi-rate multi-cast capability
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Multicast sessions are expected to be an efficient communication scheme especially for multimedia applications in mobile ad hoc networks. In this paper, we propose a new resource allocation algorithm for wireless ad hoc networks with multi-rate multi-cast capability. We use a price-based approach to solve the multi-rate multi-cast problem such that the aggregate utility for all sessions is maximized. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm not only converges within short times, but also increases the average network throughput.

articleTitle: An algorithm of solving Chinese segmentation overlapping ambiguous
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: There has been a wide variety of automatic segmentation methods with deepening study of the Chinese information processing, and the ambiguity problem is a challenge which all the methods must face. This paper summarizes the algorithms of Chinese text segmentation. Through the introduction of multiple ambiguities, it analyzes the necessity of the existence of ambiguities. On the basis of Chinese text segmentation, it offers a new overlapping ambiguity elimination algorithm based on segmentation rank. The algorithm can eliminate ambiguities and improve the efficiency and accuracy of the Chinese segmentation overlapping ambiguous.

articleTitle: Emergency transportation model of logistic material based on time-satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In accordance with the character of strict supplying timeliness to emergent material transportation, the paper introduces the time-satisfaction concept and linear time-satisfaction function and builds a mathematic model about transportation problem which aims at the best integrated time-satisfaction level. Integrated time-satisfaction function is defined by combining with the level of content, which is divided into very satisfied, general and not satisfied. Then the paper designs lexicographical algorithm and makes optimization solutions based on software program LINGO. Living examples show that this model is in line with a greater degree of emergent supplying, and afford a salutary lesson for making emergent transportation policy decision.

articleTitle: Cross-layer design for space-time block coded MIMO systems with imperfect channel state information
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: By combining adaptive modulation (AM) and automatic repeat request (ARQ), a cross-layer design (CLD) scheme for MIMO system with space-time block coding (STBC) and imperfect channel state information (CSI) is presented in this paper, and the effect of the imperfect CSI on the system performance is investigated. Based on the imperfect CSI, the probability density function of the effective signal to noise ratio (SNR) is derived, and the fading gain switching thresholds subject to a target packet loss rate and fixed power constraint are also derived. According to these results, closed-form expressions of the average spectrum efficiency (SE) and packet error rate (PER) of the system are further derived, respectively. These derived expressions include some existing expressions with perfect CSI as special cases, and can provide good performance evaluation for the CLD system with imperfect CSI. Numerical results verify the validity of the theoretical analysis. The results show that the SE and PER of the system with imperfect CSI are worse than those with perfect CSI due to the estimation error, but their performance difference will be reduced as estimation accuracy increases.

articleTitle: Application research of biosensor technology in DNA computing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Combined with the current piezoelectric genetic sensor technology and DNA computing theory, DNA computing model based on piezoelectric genetic sensor is designed. And as an example of solving the satisfiability problem, the calculation process is discussed in detail. Contrast the previous method of DNA computing, such calculation can be carried out solution detection at same time, so that the calculation process is continuous, while ensuring a high degree of parallelism and accuracy about DNA computing. This shows that the gene sensor technology has great application potential in the research field of solving the problem of computing for the use of biological macromolecules.

articleTitle: The dynamic sharing system of BitTorrent seed service: Based on EUCALYPTUS private cloud
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper will present an application of EUCALYPTUS[1] in BitTorrent[2,7] seed services as a private cloud[13]. BitTorrent download is becoming increasingly popular, which brings seed servers[3] growing bandwidth pressure. If the traditional approach by adding multiple physical machines are taken to share the flow, not only to increase costs, but also not with dynamic scalability. In addition, the increase of one physical machine is only equivalent to the addition of one seed peer. Therefore, we provide a new, efficient, dynamic and easily managed solution: making use of EUCALYPTUS private cloud system to solve the problem of how to dynamically sharing the flow of BitTorrent seed server. In this paper, we use the characteristics of EUCALYPTUS, that is can be freely and quickly to start and stop multiple VMs(virtual machine) of same content[4,5], to elastic organize quantity of seed server according to heat of a certain seed. Then, GlusterFS [10] distributed file system is used to organize the background of storage resources. Moreover, this paper also discusses the improvements of EUCALYPTUS's resource management, as well as the performance analysis of this sharing system and related improvement mechanism.

articleTitle: Setups algorithm based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: For improving the Generative Process Planning, this paper researches the auto set-up planning method. Base on defining the manufacture ability unit, this paper builds the mathematics model which makes the knowledge and context conditions as can be added dynamically constraints, the units splits of manufacture resources as decision objects, uses improved PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) method to solve. In the end, this paper gives an example to testify its validity.

articleTitle: GExcel.NET: A general-purpose adapter for Excel calculations on desktop grids
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper introduces a general-purpose adapter for the Excel calculations known as GExcel.NET. This adapter utilizes the .NET reflection and the Excel automation technologies in order to enable the parallel execution of the computation-intensive tasks on desktop grids via Alchemi. This goal is accomplished without the need to modify the calculation code as GExcel.NET enables automatic conversion from serial processing to parallel processing at runtime. Thus, the power of GExcel.NET does not only lie in enabling easy integration with Excel, but also in allowing the use of existing, non-grid enabled software components in a grid-enabled manner.

articleTitle: A DIY approach to creating smart daily services for elders living alone
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: With the increasing number of the elderly people, considerable research efforts have focused on developing homecare services. Many of these services are able to provide good cares, but most of them need professionals to configure the service environments. This paper presents a Do-It-Yourself (DIY) approach to creating smart daily services for the elders living alone. Under this approach, no specific hardware is required and the user can create a new service/application simply by performing three simple operations: (1) attaching sensor(s) to object(s), (2) taking a photo of the sensor(s) along with the object by a mobile phone's camera, and (3) setting up the service through a graphical user interface. Compared with prior studies, our work enhances the relation between objects and sensors from one-to-one to one-to-many and resolves the device access conflict among services by introducing a priority scheme. An easy-to-use graphical user interface is developed for the user to quickly set up applications/services. We also implement a prototype of the proposed approach whose practicability is demonstrated by a simple application commonly used for the elderly people.

articleTitle: A new method for interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy multiple attribute decision making
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The article proposes a new method for fuzzy multiple attribute decision making problems in which the attribute values are expressed as interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers. And in those kind problems, the attribute weights are completely unknown. Based on the deviation degree of interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy numbers, the paper innovatively extends two-phase projection model into interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy decision making problems and obtains an optimal weight vector. This article first combines projection method and set pair analysis theory. It points out the shortcoming of fuzzy set pair situation and proposes a new concept which is named as relative set pair situation. At last, the alternatives are ranked according to the corresponding relative set pair situation.

articleTitle: Cooperation spectrum sensing method based on adaptive threshold
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Considering every secondary user(SU) has its own credibility of sensed results since its different sensed environment in actual environment, this paper proposes an adaptive threshold-based cooperative spectrum sensing scheme, which adjusts the local false-alarm probability of SUs based on the credibility of each SU, and adjusts thethreshold of each SU adaptively. The simulation results show that, the proposed method has improved system detection probability obviously, comparing with traditional cooperation spectrum sensing methods.

articleTitle: Research on grammar structure-based tactic recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Tactic is an abstract concept. Most of the tactics consist of series of actions, related action time and features. And the tactics reflect the agent's temporary goal in a given time. Tactic recognition can be of great use in the domains of special force, video games and so on. Analyzing the human player's action sequence, the tactic patterns can be extracted out. In this paper, we analyze the single-soldier tactics and propose a grammar structure-based description for tactics. With this method, most of the tactics can be described in a formal way and build a tactic library. When the game running, player's input and certain key feature can be recorded and with a recognition algorithm the agent action sequence can be recognized as tactics.

articleTitle: Design and application of control system for go-self high-field-gap rice variable manure spreader
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Go-self high-field-gap rice variable manure spreader always uses high-field-gap special designed batholiths and manure spreading device, however, there exist some problems in its hydraulic drive system and rowing manure controlling unit, such as paddy field manure spreader in low field-gap, spreading manure quantity adjusting technology draggled, low work efficiency, etc. According to the manure spreader producing course and its structure parameters, AT89C51 singlechip is used as a core control element in the control system, controlling performance experiments of the manure spreader for spreading manure was made on ground and rice field. The results show that the performance of special designed control table achieved expecting require, and the control system meet the requirements.

articleTitle: A color-based scale-invariant interest points matching approach
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The scale-invariant interest points matching approaches always require a lot of computation and sometimes fail to meet the real-time demands in some application fields. To solve the problem, a new local scale-invariant descriptor based on the image color information is proposed in this paper. The descriptor consists of concentric circle structure which is divided into several subregions. The radiuses of the concentric circles are proportional to the scale factor, and the coordinates of the descriptor rotate in relation to the interest point orientation. Meanwhile, the descriptor chooses the mean values of different color components R, G, B in each subregion as the feature vector's elements to reduce the descriptor's dimension. Compared with other descriptors, this descriptor is robust to many image transformations and is indicative of less computation. The performance of the approach is analyzed in theory in this paper and the experimental results have certified its validity too.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation framework for communication satellite system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The effectiveness evaluation framework for communication satellite systems is proposed, integrating the top-down analysis with bottom-up synthesis. The framework includes two parts: holistic analysis and synthesis. This paper chooses information transmission delay as the measures of effectiveness for communication satellite system. In the first part of the framework, ingredients of the system and relations between them are determined by building systematological model. In the second part, the MAS (Multi-Agent System) architecture of communication satellite system and behavior rules of a single communication satellite Agent is studied by applying MAS modeling & simulation method. Finally the rationality of the framework proposed in this paper is validated on AnyLogic platform.

articleTitle: Use of narration to develop an audio video describer for the sight impaired
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Visually impaired individuals are unable to go through their daily activities normally and one of the main deprivations caused by it is the access to information for learning a challenge for independent living. Due to this limitation the researchers explore the use of narration for description and integrate this to a chosen Malay short movie film with the belief that lessons can be learned from movie films and may reflect significant values to one's life. In developing the Audio Video describer (AVD) it made use of video editing software to incorporate the description of movie scenes. The developed experimental model of the audio video describer was evaluated by thirty six sighted students in terms of language, voice, pitch and timing used for audio description. A teacher-made questionnaire used in the survey contained 10 items on respondents' feeling and experience of viewing the AVD model. It was rated in a 5 point Likert scale from 1 strongly disagree to 5 strongly agree. The results showed that through the use of narration, the audio video describer model is suitable to help the sight impaired understand the movie. The current research will progress by using the experimental model to sight impaired school children for its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A forecasting model of time series based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In accordance with the forecasting problem of the short-term traffic flow, a prediction model based on wavelet neural network was put forward. And then, by analyzing the influencing factors about short-term traffic flow, the forecasting method of short-term time series is constructed. Compared with other methods, the model can effectively improve the forecasting accuracy. The experimental results show that the model is very effective for the prediction of the short-term traffic flow.

articleTitle: Research on interactive visual simulation method of Chinese fir stand growth and cutting process
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Based on the current status of forest visual simulation and tree growth-oriented management theory, and referring to fir stand growth and management process interact, the paper analysed the stand management process and growth interact process, combining with stand growth modal, the paper designed a visual simulation approach of management and stand growth interact feedback. By using the stand growth result and stand management measurement as interface parameter, analysing process defined management plan, by real-time scheduling algorithm parsing the management process, and by using management processes and stand growth dynamic visualization to get the final result of stimulation management result. Sub-fir growth and management process simulation for interactive visualization can provide a scientific basis for management planning and decision-making.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of PWM inverter output common-mode voltage reduction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Aimed at the common-mode voltage produced by PWM inverter in motor drive system, the reduction method of three-level PWM inverter output common-mode voltage is investigated. This paper gave the basic principle of three-level inverter, and according to the relation between switch state and the corresponding space vector, then came to a conclusion that common-mode voltage can be reduced by using improved reference vector composes with zero voltage vector and medium voltage vector. At the same time, an improvement space vector modulation program is proposed to reduce the common-mode voltage. The program is simulated by PS IM platform, the simulation results conform to the theory analysis.

articleTitle: A new scheme to synchronization a fractional-order hyperchaotic system and computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper, a fractional-order hyperchaotic system is proposed. By computer simulations, it is found that hyperchaos exists in the new fractional-order four dimensional system with order less than one. Using the pole placement technique, a nonlinear state observer and is designed to synchronize a class of nonlinear fractional-order systems. In addition, the function projective synchronization between the new integer-order hyperchaotic system and the fractional-order hyperchaotic system. The two schemes, based on the stability theory of the fractional-order system, are rather simple, theoretically rigorous and convenient to realize synchronization. Numerical results are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed synchronization schemes.

articleTitle: Research on polar coordinate interpolation algorithm based on particle movement
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of processing face milling in turning center, this paper presents the polar coordinate interpolation algorithm based on particle movement. When processing face milling in the turning center, the feed instruction of programming should be converted from Cartesian coordinates to machine movement coordinates by the control system. Firstly, analyzed the structure of machine tool, combined with the characteristics of particle's movement in polar coordinate system, the equation of kinematics transform is constituted between the Cartesian coordinates and polar coordinates. Then according to the above conversion relationship, the polar coordinates linear and circular interpolation algorithms are provided. Finally, based on this algorithm, the function of polar coordinates interpolation is implemented. According to this study, on the existing movement trajectory planning method, the algorithm is not only able to implement the dynamic conversion in the real-time interpolation but also can simplify numerical control programming and improve the machining efficiency.

articleTitle: A fuzzy and integrated evaluation in the security of digital library
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: As digital libraries grow rapidly in recent years, the security of digital library becomes the key issue concerned by administrators of digital libraries. Effective evaluation of digital library security is of great significance for the library administrator. This paper proposes a fuzzy integrated Security evaluation method which is based on man-computer combined data collection and fuzzy expert evaluation in Delphi method. The method could reduce the subjectivity of expert evaluation and alleviate the difficulty of data collection and makes possible a better combination of qualitative and quantitative evaluations. Firstly, the evaluation factor and hierarchy structure of digital library security evaluation is constructed. Secondly, data is colleted and according to the evaluation comment of each expert, the subjection degree matrix is constructed. Finally, a new concept of “degree of assurance” is presented for the quantificational evaluation of security. In this paper a case is presented to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Research of pulsed-doppler radar jamming system based on DDS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: An new jamming system which used to pulsed-doppler radar was introduced in this paper. Firstly, the configuration and its characteristic of jamming system based on digital frequency synthesizer was analyzed and simulated. Then, the collimated precision and equation of extent and phases of pulsed-doppler radar was analyzed, on the condition of jamming affected. This technology and corresponding arithmetic was simulated in computed. The simulation results show that the jamming effect of jamming system based on digital frequency synthesizer was comparatively well, and can diffusely applied to pulsed-doppler radar.

articleTitle: Audio information hiding algorithm based on energy compare
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper presents an audio information hiding algorithm based on energy compare. It embeds a speech as the secret message into original audio signal, and transmits the secret message in the public channel. Using energy compare method, the original audio information not only have good transparency but also has strong anti-disturbance ability against noise, compression and filter.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation research on supply chain based on AHP and modified grey relational analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Supply chain performance evaluation is based on the supply chain evaluation index system, and it uses quantity statistics and operational research via quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis, is the performance for a certain period on its supply chain(include support performance, operation performance and final performance), sequentially it can judge in a objective, impartial and accurate way. This paper has confirmed index weight in the supply chain performance evaluation via AHP and modified grey relational analysis. Utilizing modified grey relational analysis to analyze synthetically, it can make a performance evaluation for GOME target supply chain, and pick up the optimum supplier. This paper has provided sufficient data for enterprises selecting suppliers and optimizing supply chain, thereby achieving the target for optimizing enterprise supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on visualization of coal quality information of coal face
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The distribution of coal seams and coal quality of the coal face is depicted using the coal seam samples from airway, conveyer roadway and working face. Then the coal property data of the mined area and the related geological data are used to forecast the coal quality. This paper builds a three-dimensional model for the coal quality information of coal face on front-Web using JavaScript and three-dimensional display, transforming three-dimensional physical coordinates into screen coordinates. A multi-browser supportable drawing method with SVG and VML is used to realize the three-dimensional dynamic display of face's coal quality information under the developmental environment of MyEclipse6.5. The results of experiment show that this paper presents a three-dimensional modeling method of coal seams based on JavaScript language, SVG and VML technology, and successfully applies it to coal information management system with the framework of Ibatis + Spring + Webwork, achieving the visualization of coal quality information based on multi-browser support, which will be helpful to the further research and extension of WebGIS in the field of three-dimensional visualization.

Author Keywords: three-dimensional model of the coal seams

articleTitle: Improved DV-Hop algorithm for high accuracy and low energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Most improved DV-Hop algorithms focus on the localization accuracy while underemphasize the energy conservation. In order to enhance the energy saving of wireless sensor networks, these algorithms need to be further improved. Upgrading the positioned nodes to be new-born anchors is an economical scheme to expedite unknown nodes localization and reduce total localization rounds, thus favor energy saving. Using the scheme of upgrading positioned nodes, this paper proposes a new algorithm based on DV-Hop, which restricts the hop counts between unknown nodes and anchors to reduce the energy consumption in flooding broadcast of anchors information. To decrease the impact of new-born anchors' location errors on the positioning accuracy of unknown nodes, the upgrading round sequence of a new-born anchor is defined as the generation to distinguish its error influences. Taking the hop counts and the generations as weighting factors, the paper presents a new weighted average one-hop distance processing method to guarantee the localization accuracy. Simulation and analysis results show that the new algorithm can effectively decrease the positioning error and total localization rounds to take account of both the energy consumption and the accuracy of localization.

articleTitle: New Relative Concatenate Sorting algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Sorting is technique by which elements are arranged in a particular order following some characteristic or law [1]. In this paper we presented an algorithm called as Relative Concatenate Sort, which is based on the idea of Selection Sort, but it divides the list into two. After dividing the list it takes the average of both halves of the list. Comparing this average with elements it sorts both arrays and then put these arrays together to get the final sorted list.

articleTitle: A new bus vehicle condition monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A new vehicle condition monitoring system for public transportation tools like buses is introduced in this paper. Comparing to the traditional one, this new system could provide video monitoring for nearly all the areas within or surrounding a bus. Four video are obtained and transmitted to main controller, then combined together and displayed on one screen. The main controlling system is realized on FPGA. Experiments showed that this system could give a good the image quality while satisfying the real-time video broadcasting demanding.

articleTitle: Application analysis of laser scanning technology in trees measurement
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper introduced the procedure of forest measurement using three-dimensional laser scanning and summarized the method of data processing by the experiment in Xiaolong Mountain of Gansu Province. The way of establishing 3D visualization model of trees using 3D laser scanning data was brought forward as well. And model accuracy was verified. The results show that the model reconstructed using this method can not only be measured with high accuracy of the tree measurement factors such as height and DBH to meet the requirements of forestry survey, but also provide multitudinous 3D models of single tree for the 3D visualization simulation of stand and landscape.

articleTitle: Streaming media service quality monitoring system “QualView”
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Streaming media service is the representative and important service in 3G period. This paper describes the motivation, methodology, and characteristic of QualView system which is mainly used for monitoring the mobile steaming media service. QualView system is based on end-to-end QoS architecture and integrates many functions such as: end-user behavior simulation, data collection, parameter extraction, QoS evaluation, failure alarm and so on. It makes objective parameters of the network associate with the user perceived QoE by building an association model. Experiment results show it is efficient and effective in fault locating and QoS evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the method of simulation of capsule's impact under sea wave
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: When a capsule impacts onto the sea waves, its impact load and movement are more complex than that of the capsule impacting onto the static water due to the wave impact of the sea. Based on the method of ALE (Arbitrary Lagrange Euler), a numerical-wave-tank that has good repeatability and stability is built. This provides the basis of calculating the coupling force when the capsule impact onto the sea with any kind of the wave conditions. The study of capsule's impact onto the sea waves may provide the reference for capsule's design and manufacture for landing onto the sea by accidence or by plan. The results show that horizontal velocity has a significant effect to the maximum impact acceleration of the capsule under wave conditions, which is not under static water.

articleTitle: Research on VSP under VMI
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper studied the Vehicle Scheduling Problem under the managerial thinking of Vendor Managed Inventory (abbreviated as VMI). It particularly established the mathematical model and the iterative optimization algorithm to deal with the issues of integration of inventory management and distribution transport under VMI mode, and proved that these approaches can play roles in optimization of reducing distribution cost for logistics distribution system of supply chain.

articleTitle: Study on SaaS architecture of Web3D scene content management platform and method of editing and browsing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: This paper presents a SaaS architecture of Web3D scene content management platform, including browser side and cloud computing platform side. Browser side is used to provide web user interface interaction and RPC functionality. Cloud computing platform side is for handling business logic and sending the scene code to the browser side. In addition, this paper also delves into three-dimensional scene editing and browsing method based on the architecture. The method implements the seamless integration of the current web standards and achieves real-time management of online three-dimensional scene.

articleTitle: Return and exit mechanism of troubleshooting based on auto-triggered method for TEM vacuum system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: According to request of the vacuum system on the status of various failures on TEM, return and exit mechanisms based on auto-triggered method is designed for troubleshooting. By analyzing the failure modes and the response measurement, the emergency operation plan is determined, the fault handling process is planned, and the return and exit mechanism is established. By auto-triggered mode, the vacuum control system achieves automatic response to a variety of failure and reasonable handling so as to ensure the stable operation of TEM. Through the actual operation, the test results show that the return and exit mechanism of troubleshooting is effective, and the failure processing based on auto-triggered method satisfies the system requirements.

articleTitle: On clustering networks with PageRank
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Network clustering has attracted increasing attention in various fields. In this paper we build a PageRank based clustering scheme and use it to cluster some classic problems, such as karate club and American college football networks. Compared with other known algorithms, experiments show that our algorithm has a shorter running time and uncovers community structure more successfully.

articleTitle: The GEO satellites and space debris optical angle measuring system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A small diameter optical telescope with a drift scanning CCD camera, the associated softwares and hardwares can be combined to constitute a set of optical angle measuring system. The alternation between the drift scanning mode and the staring mode for observing the background stars and the GEO objects, makes the GEO satellite optical observations to become more convenient and greatly reduces the observing intensity. By means of high-precision astrometric catalog, the ground-based optical angle measuring system can provide high-precision angle measurement data of the GEO satellites and space debris, and thus achieve accurate orbit determination for them. The analysis results of observation show that the system can provide much more precious angle measurement data with a small diameter telescope than the current technologies, and the difference of the precision can be up to an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Smoothing filter-based image fusion of object and scene
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Since the existing fusion method of object and scene that is based on IHS transform has a defect: emergence of the scene image's illusion in target area, this paper proposes an smoothing filter-based algorithm through smoothing target areas of the hue component and saturation component of the new scene image which are used to carry out IHS inverse transform. Subjective quality evaluation and objective quality assessment data of comparative fusion experiment results show that the new algorithm not only can get rid of the drawback of the existing object-scene fusion method based on IHS transform effectively and achieve better fusion result in the application of object-scene fusion, but also performs fast.

articleTitle: A RS/GIS-based architecture for monitoring agricultural disasters
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: One system for monitoring agricultural disasters based on RS and GIS is developed. This system essentially plays two roles: implementing the information from RS and GIS associated with agricultural disaster modeling, and increasing precision of agricultural disaster modeling by the information representing physical and logical fusion objects subject to agricultural disaster monitoring.

articleTitle: Study on joint probability density algorithm in multi-sensor data fusion
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Joint probability density algorithm (JPDA) is a novel algorithm in multi-sensor data fusion and it provides a new approach for target localization. Generally, more sensors could make higher precision of localization when JPDA is adopted, but there is no full theoretical support so far. According to the region of interesting (ROI) generated by JPDA in Cartesian coordinates, the information entropy of JPDA is analyzed. The expression of information entropy of multi-sensor which is the theoretical basis of JPDA is deduced. The result indicates that no matter how many sensors there are, the entropy is determined only by the determinant of covariance matrix, more sensors make information entropy lower which is the reason why localization precision is higher. Simulation results verify our analysis.

articleTitle: An identification method of load harmonic current based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Based on the theory of differential equation model of nonlinear load, an identification method of load harmonic current using BP neural network is proposed. Considering time-varying frequency, the fundamental frequency and voltage on the load can be determined by the windowed discrete Fourier transform and double spectral line interpolation. In order to improve the generalization ability of BP neural network, voltage and current data measured at the connection point of utility grid is checked and Bayesian regularization algorithm is adopted. With the trained BP neural network describing the nonlinear load, the current incented by the fundamental voltage can be obtained. The simulation results demonstrate that the total harmonic distortion of the load current based on BP neural network is almost independent of power capacity and harmonic voltage within the range of utility grid harmonic voltage limits, which is beneficial to the division of harmonic responsibility and harmonic control.

articleTitle: LDGR: An efficient load-balancing inter Dimension Group Routing selection strategy in on-chip networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Load balance is critical to the performance of adaptive routing algorithm for on-chip interconnection networks. Load Balance is mainly depended on the algorithm's selection strategy which is employed when the algorithm's routing function returns more than one admissible output ports. Existing selection strategies use local congestion metrics to make a port selection decision while ignore the global congestion condition, thus results in sub-optimal selections. In this paper, we propose an efficient Load-balancing inter Dimension Group Routing selection strategy (LDGR) in on-chip networks. The proposed selection strategy takes into account the neighbor's free VC count when make a routing decision. LDGR can achieve load balance over a wider area beyond local area by balancing the load of both X dimension link group and Y dimension link group. The evaluation result indicates that the proposed method outperforms local selection strategy in throughput about 13.4% on average under synthetic traffics patterns on 8×8 mesh topology.

articleTitle: Study on the coupled bending-torsional vibration of unbalanced rotor system with external excitations
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In order to research characteristics of unbalanced rotor system with external excitations, a dynamic model of rotor was established. This model not only considered the influences of the gyroscopic effect and the gravity, but also includes two kinds of unbalance which named static/dynamic unbalance. Use the hypothesis of small angle, expression of forces and torque which caused by translation and rotational of these two unbalances and gravity was derived in detail. Using the Lagrange method with six degree of freedom, motion equations of the system were derived. Combined Runge-Kutta approach, dynamic equations of the model were solved. Moreover, nonlinear vibration characteristics were analyzed by means of three kinds of diagrams. Thus, theoretical foundations are established for optimization design and fault diagnosis of rotor-bearing system.

articleTitle: Design of remote control system for PC based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Recently, the multimedia-based pedagogy has been increasingly applied. It is highly inconvenient for the communication and interaction between teachers and students with such a teaching method, in which teachers are consequently constrained to where they should constantly operate computer. Although there are some monofunctional computer remote control devices in the market, they are not well enough to meet the teaching demands. This thesis proposes a design of a computer remote control system, which improves PC remote control equipment at this stage. This design based on NEC code for infrared codes, by using Visual Basic to program computer console applications, monitoring the real-time data sent by the microcontroller, contrasting the control code table, and via calling the Windows API to send a message, thus implementing the direct operation of a separate application. The design is particularly suitable for remote control based on multimedia programs, and is really useful for teachers in the multimedia-based pedagogy.

articleTitle: A software architecture for the distributed enterprise solution
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet information technologies, a variety of programming language, technology platform emerge in endlessly. Companies are now in urgent need is to developed a distributed middleware platform with standard interface protocol, shielding the details to achieve a rapid development of information technology. This paper introduces a new way to deal with the problem. Paper first analyzes the problems of distributed enterprise architecture and current status of the specific issues. Then propose an idea of modular middleware platform architecture based on the neutral technology. Through the establishment of a standard service package modules and enterprise common data model to integrate data resources of heterogeneous systems; in the internal environment use SOA thinking to process a business process reengineering to improve its business processes optimize, finally form a complete distributed middleware platform architecture.

articleTitle: Multiresolution image inpainting
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Image inpainting is the process of reconstructing the missing or damaged contents inside an image in a perceptually plausible way. Although over ten years of research has made the inpainting results suitable for starting to enter real applications, the state-of-the-art methods still suffer from heavy computational complexity and artifacts such as blurring and false edges, especially in large inpainting areas. In this paper we propose a multiresolution approach to image inpainting. In this framework, the image pyramid is first established. Then inpainting is carried out for a chosen low resolution image in the pyramid. Afterwords the information in this repaired low resolution image is propagated through each higher resolution image until the original highest resolution image is inpainted. Compared to the current methods used, the proposed approach holds advantages such as the ease of filling large areas with better results, faster speed, and better conformation with human vision process. Experimental results show that the proposed multiresolution inpainting framework can produce perceptually better results and runs over three times faster than state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: The analytical methods based on the distributed storage system I/O performance model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The performance of storage system is vital to the storage system itself and the application of storage systems. I/O performance is one of the most important performance indexes for applications based on the distributed storage system. Because I/O performance has already become the bottleneck of the whole performance of distributed systems for a long time, I/O performance analysis and optimization method looks especially important and valuable. In the paper, I/O performance model, I/O performance index architecture and a set of the performance analysis method is presented, which may be used to evaluate distributed storage performance, and support the schedule of the storage application task.

articleTitle: The key theorem of statistical learning theory based on rough fuzzy number
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper, we give some new concepts of rough fuzzy expected risk functional, rough fuzzy empirical risk functional and rough fuzzy empirical risk minimization principal based on rough fuzzy number. At last, we give and prove the key theorem based on rough fuzzy number, which plays an important role in the statistical learning theory.

Author Keywords: rough fuzzy empirical risk minimization principal

articleTitle: Extended Guess-Answer: Preventing velocity-based linkage attacks in location-based services
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: When mobile users search points of interest in location based services, they should always provide their accurate locations, which may leak location privacy of themselves. A typical approach to protect user location privacy is to generate a cloaked region (CR) that encloses the user position. However, if locations are continuously reported, an attacker can correlate CRs from multiple timestamps to accurately pinpoint the user position within a CR. In this paper, we present a novel approach, called Extended Guess-Answer, to protect against velocity-based linkage attacks in location based services. Through the interaction between the user and the server, a cloaked region that contains user current location can be generated. The experimental results show that our approach is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: An EMD based simulation of the drum resistance torque spectrum of a shearer
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In tradition cutting coal-rock load model, fluctuate of drum resistance torque is described motionless stochastic processes by statistics. However, tradition model always adopts immobile processes, which results in a stiff approximation of the corresponding cutting processes. In this work, an EMD based simulation of the drum resistance torque method is proposed to overcome this limitation by introducing fractal theory and EMD decomposition. The drum cutting process is the release of its energy levels, resulting in a resulting in a keen resistance curve fractal. The EMD and fractal theory is more capable of capturing the mechanical sharp coal-rock than that of traditional statistic's method. The influence of the parameter drums geometric and coal-rock material are studied. Numerical examples show that the proposed method can provide a better solution than that of the statistical approach.

articleTitle: Research on helmet-mounted sight system model and simulation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The article reported an investigation into the mechanism of helmet-mounted sight system(HMSS) based on photogrammetry techniques. It demonstrated how was the fire force system controlled by line of pilots' sight. Pose and attitude of helmet were estimated by detecting 4 LEDs installed on the helmet through two cameras. Helmet and pilot's head were regarded as rigid body. The model defining interrelations between sight and LED projection image was described in detail. The working principle of the system was validated on our simulation platform, which was developed with OpenGL APIs and in VC environment. In order to get the accurate image, the projecting model should be adjusted according to the calibration result of real camera. The simulation result was in accordance with preset pose and attitude of helmet. This article described the structure of helmet, model of estimating 3D pose from 2D images, imaging simulation of camera. It may provide help for understanding, designing and improving the HMSS in some extent.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of physical evidence management system based on the Internet of Things intelligent perception technology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Physical evidence is the most immediate and effective tool for public security bureau to analyze and solve a case. In this paper, the Internet of Things intelligent perception technology was applied to physical evidence management, based on the sufficient research on the problems of physical evidence management. And combined the character of the business of public security, a physical evidence management system based on the Internet of Things intelligent perception technology has been formed. The principle and structure of the system are reported in this paper, and the subsystems are also introduced.

articleTitle: A separable formation system based on multi-leader
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Current approaches to organizing units in fps game or real-time strategy games are typically implemented via static formations. Static formations are not capable of adapting effectively to opponent tactics. In this paper we discuss an approach to organizing units based on multi-leader, and when faced with complex terrain, the formation can separate and then reassembled. This approach to establish so-called a separable formation system based on multi-leader, is tested in the UDK game environment. From our results, we may conclude that the approach to established formations can be successfully applied in actual game environments.

articleTitle: Design of the wireless temperature supervisory control system based on eZ430-RF2500
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper, we put forward system universal model architecture for wireless supervisory control system according to the current research in this field, then we design the sensor node hardware which is based on eZ430-RF2500 to solve the power supply when the sensor node is in a bad condition, finally we design the wireless temperature supervisory control system software to test the effects, the performance of the system have been proved real-time and efficient. This design method can be widely used in various areas of supervisory control environment.

articleTitle: Researches on simulation and validation of airborne enhanced ground proximity warning system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper, enhanced ground proximity warning simulation and validation system is designed and implemented. First, based on square grid and sub-grid structure, the global digital terrain database is designed and constructed. Terrain data searching is implemented through querying the latitude and longitude bands and separated zones of global terrain database with the current aircraft position. A combination of dynamic scheduling and hierarchical scheduling is adopted to schedule the terrain data, and the terrain data can be read and delete dynamically in the memory. Secondly, according to the scope, distance, approach speed information etc. to the dangerous terrain in front, and using security profiles calculating method, collision threat detection is executed in real-time, and provides caution and warning alarm. According to this scheme, the implementation of the enhanced ground proximity warning simulation system is realized. Simulations are carried out to verify a good real-time in terrain display and alarm trigger, and the results show simulation system is realized correctly, reasonably and stable.

articleTitle: A pattern matching scheme for accurate medicine localization in automatic pharmacy inventory
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A vision based automatic pharmacy inventory is an unstructured environment in the sense that a random face of medicine box confronts the camera according to how it is put on shelf. This poses a challenge to traditional image content based object detection algorithms. In this paper we propose a shape-based medicine box localization framework. Instead of using feature point or texture based method which depends on image content, the proposed method adopts a pattern matching scheme, which takes advantage of the object's shape to build a synthetic pattern, for object localization. The superiority of our method lies in three-folds: 1) the proposed method is robust to frontal image content variation and does not depend on single image to make identification and localization; 2) the pattern matching scheme is robust to object perspective transform; 3) the method is insensitive to noises introduced by clutter environment, such as unbalanced illumination and reflection. To evaluate the proposed method, we test it in the real application environment. Large scale experiment shows the accuracy and robustness of our method.

articleTitle: Research on substation knowledge semantic exchange model based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: IEC 61850 adopts object-oriented modeling techniques to model business functions of the substation, and defines substation configuration description object model by Substation Configuration description Language (SCL). SCL which is based on XML Schema cannot description the knowledge semantic and achieve substation knowledge exchanging of substation automation system. in this article, knowledge semantic of substation was analyzed and modeled based on ontology technology, including the relationships and constrains of substation knowledge semantic. By extending the label definition of SCL, the semantic exchange model is proposed and description ability of SCL is improved.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of multi-network adapter bonding technology based on multi-core processor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Considering of the current IP-SAN network link performance bottlenecks and single points of failure, we studied the existing Linux bonding technology. Multi-network Adapter Bonding Technology can improve the speed of access to IP-SAN, and can reduce the link failure caused by a single point of failure. We introduced the existing Linux bonding technology in this paper, proposed and implemented a Multinetwork Adapter Bonding method based on multi-core processors. To evaluate performance of this method, We used Embedded Server based on multi-core processors to do the test, the performance of Linux bonding technology is used as a contrast. According to the test results, the multi-network adapter bonding method which we proposed in this paper, can significantly increase the embedded server to access the IPSAN speed and flexibility<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Receding horizon estimators for systems with delayed state and measurement
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper we propose a receding horizon estimator (filter) for discrete-time stochastic linear systems with delays in state and measurement. A novel filtering algorithm is designed based on the receding horizon strategy in order to achieve high estimation accuracy and stability under parametric uncertainties. The new receding horizon filter uses a set of recent observations with appropriately chosen initial horizon conditions. The key contribution is the derivation of Lyapunov-like equations for receding horizon mean and covariance of system state with an arbitrary number of time delays. The numerical example demonstrates the proposed algorithm is more robust and more accurate than Kalman filter against dynamic model uncertainties.

articleTitle: Exploiting web features in Chinese relation extraction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Relation extraction is a form of information extraction, which finds predefined relations between pairs of entities in text. A Chinese relation extraction approach exploiting web features is proposed. Four web features are extracted from the web and the Wikipedia website. Experiments on the ACE 2005 Corpus show that the web features are effective, and high-quality websites generate more effective features.

articleTitle: The research on automatic translation of Chinese-Mongolian numerals
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In Chinese-Mongolian hybrid machine translation, for numerals that including the open words of infinite vocabulary we can not use statistical method to translate all numerals in real text, so we proposed rule-based method to translate the numerals terms. This paper used rule-based method to complete translation of Chinese-Mongolian numerals. In addition, we also completed the translation of Chinese-Mongolian temporal words. It is proved by experiments that the performance of the Chinese-Mongolian machine translation system can be improved by this method.

articleTitle: Rapid trajectory optimization using an improved pseudpspectral method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Combined the standard pseudospectral (PS) method with mesh refinement method, an adaptive PS method is presented for rapidly solving trajectory optimization problems. Regard the violations in the discredited deferential-algebraic equations (dynamic constraints and path constraints) at midpoints of the collocation points in each segment as the criterion. Mesh refinement is achieved by using trajectory curvature-based density function to redistribute the mesh points. The algorithm iterates until the accuracy criterion is satisfied to a user-specified tolerance. Simulations indicate that the proposed adaptive PS method is more efficient than the standard PS method.

articleTitle: Study on designing of dyadic wavelet filters with vanishing moments
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A new method of designing dyadic wavelet filters with higher vanishing moments is proposed by using dyadic lifting scheme which has been developed recently by us. Based on the method new spline dyadic wavelet filters have been constructed and applied to the enhancement of medical images. Results of experiments show that efficient of images which are enhanced by new spline dyadic wavelet filters are better.

articleTitle: Design of a new type Signal-Centralized-Locking System based on PLC and Profibus
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A scheme is put forward in this paper of distributed control system based on programmable logic controller (PLC) and Profibus to solve the vast control scope, wiring complexity, high cost and maintenance inconvenience in coal mine Signal-Centralized-Locking System (SCLS). The implementation of controlling hardware is well discussed, and details of the configuration process are analyzed as well. The advantages of strong real-time capability, low coast and easy extensibility have been manifested in various applications of this system.

articleTitle: A faster color-based clustering method for summarizing photos in smartphone
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Many people use smartphones which feature cameras and large storage capacities. They have comfortable features that allow the recording of daily life and encourage them to take hundreds of photos. However, their limited screen sizes cause browsing problems with large photo set. In addition, organizing photos by manual is a hard and tediuous work. Therefore, a way to classify photos to events and a better visualization method are needed. Much research has automatically classified photos to easily present and manage collections. However, most algorithm were designed for computers, not for smartphones which have limited computing power. This paper describes a fast and lightweight spatial clustering method to summarize and visualize smartphone photos by event. We defined a nearly identical photos which are taken by people in order to get better quality photos. These photos do not need to visualize duplicately since they show same event. We calculated each photo's similarity and focused on eliminating inefficient steps to measure it. The CIELAB color space was selected to accurately measure color differences and quantize colors. We extracted nearly identical photos and cut events by optimal matching with each photo's color histogram. Our method changed the color quantization technique and accelerated clustering speed by >;20 while retaining precision and recall.

articleTitle: Shape from gradient fields using kernel Poisson equation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Shape from gradient fields is a traditional issue in image processing and computer vision fields, and is also the final step for many applications. Most methods convert the problem to Poisson equation and project the original data to another space like Fourier and Discrete Cosine Domain. In this paper we propose a kernel method to solve Poisson equation. By converting the traditional Poisson equation to its kernel representation form, the underlying surface can be recovered by least squares. With further considering an even extension of the original gradient field, Gram matrix becomes balanced and the recovered surface will not oscillate at boundary. The special processing of boundary assumes a Neumann boundary condition instead of Dietrich boundary, which is more useful in practical situation. The experimental results validate the superiority of the proposed method over existing ones.

articleTitle: Numerical study of limit cycles for two perturbed integrable non-Hamiltonian systems
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Bifurcation of limit cycles for two perturbed integrable non-Hamiltonian systems is investigated by using both qualitative analysis and numerical exploration. The investigation is based on detection functions which are particularly effective for the integrable non-Hamiltonian systems with perturbed terms. The study reveals that the perturbed non-Hamiltonian system (6) has only 3 limit cycles, whereas the perturbed integrable non-Hamiltonian system (7) has 4 limit cycles. By using method of numerical simulation, the distributed orderliness of these limit cycles is observed, and their nicety places are determined. The study also indicates that each of these limit cycles passes the corresponding nicety point.

articleTitle: Thresholding strategy in passive detection via wavelet filter banks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate thresholding algorithms applied in wavelet filter bank (FB) based passive detection in radar and sonar systems. Addressing a random emission with unknown parameters, the emission and the received signal are modelled by a Gaussian process with unknown mean and variance. The wavelet FB decomposes the received signal into subchannels. A decision on the absence and presence of the emission is then made by thresholding against the FB outputs. Formulae are derived to prove the detection performance using different thresholding strategies. A graphical comparison of the detection performances with different strategies and in different scenarios is presented. Design principles are derived under this wavelet FB based detection framework.

articleTitle: A new service scenario implementation in UPSIOT platform
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: A wild variety of applications will become a major driving force and ultimate goal of the development of the IOT, so to realize different services from various areas, has become its biggest challenge for its development. How to design a service platform that could accommodate a variety of service applications have become a basic need for lots of fields. In this thesis, we propose a platform that can extract, describe, composite, publish and support the implementation of the service of the IOT, and lastly can realize the unified treatment of the service. In order to construct a stable ubiquitous service platform environment and provide users with scalable service applications, we propose a new platform Ubiquitous Service Platform for the Internet Of Things (USPIOT). The platform not only can effectively find the new services, but also provide users with a reliable mechanism for the implementation of the service. We paper focuses on describing the service processing and meanwhile giving the experimental validation of the platform. The result proves that the new platform can meet a large number of service applications of the IOT and has good stability and scalability.

articleTitle: A heuristic algorithm for Euclidean Steiner Minimal Tree inside simple polygon
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: The Steiner problem leads to solutions in several scientific and business applications. Computer networks routing and electronic integrated circuits are few examples of it. Assuming some points in the Euclidean plane, we can construct a minimum spanning tree connecting these (terminal) nodes. It is possible to add some extra points (Steiner Points) in order to decrease the length of this tree, which would in turn lead to Euclidean Steiner Minimal Tree (ESMT). This problem is considered as a NP-hard problem, as it may contain some nodes that are not in the set of given nodes. Assuming a simple polygon P with m vertices and n terminals in it, we try to find an Euclidean Steiner minimal tree connecting all these n terminals in P. In this paper, we propose a new solution based on the straight skeleton of a simple polygon for finding Euclidean Steiner tree of any number of terminals, in a given simple polygon.

articleTitle: Separability-based relevance feedback for content-based image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: Relevance feedback is an interactive querying process of CBIR, which can help the retrieval system adapt to the dynamic user demand and achieve more accuracy for the representation of image similarity according to the user's view. In this paper, we bring up the concept of the separability of image data as the theoretical criterion to guide generating the best feature vector set to better classify images. We build an energy function for the training of the eigenvectors on the basis of separability, and then apply simulated annealing optimization algorithm to minimize energy function in order to accomplish the generation of the optimal feature vectors set in a particular database. The experiment result shows that this new algorithm for relevance feedback can effectively improve the retrieval accuracy.

articleTitle: A method on safe data transmission with lossless compression
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: We propose a method on safe data transmission for the embedded system, which is convenient and of high computational efficiency. This method not only removes the redundancy by re-encoding the not frequently changed information between two adjacent data, but also encrypts the frame by Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) algorithm after scrambling it with a random matrix. The experimental results show a good security of data transmission and a certain compression effect. Due to the slow variance in the collected data of embedded system and the existence of large historical data redundancy, the method mentioned above is more suitable for the embedded system than the conventional methods.

articleTitle: An improved RBAC model and its application in a Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: To achieve high efficiency in human resource management, University Human Resource Management Information System (UHRMIS in short) requires hierarchical architecture, clearly defined modules and effective cooperation of multiple users. So this paper presents Improved Role Based Access Control model (IRBAC model in short), a new access control model and the application of IRBAC model in UHRMIS is also covered. IRBAC model has realized flexible configuration on access control, provided different security degrees and decreased hidden dangerous factors caused by discretionary authorization so as to lay reliable foundations for higher efficiency of UHRMIS.

articleTitle: Study on visual simulation of stand structure from forest from map
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Automation Engineering (CSAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and computer technology has improved; visualization technology has been widely used in various fields. In forestry, forestry visualization technology breakthrough two limiting factors in the time span and spatial scales, and increasingly become a research hotspot. If we build a virtual forest environment, forestry workers would make more convenient and intuitive, efficient management and research forest. However, visualization of the data source demanded strict, and need to be collected more data to visualization. These would be brought great difficulties to the study.
